name: TrueCombat: Platinum 0.39.1
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.39.1**
**Patch Notes #68**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.39.1-sandbox38

A fix update for 0.39.0: working voice chat, steadier shadows, cleaner competitive matches and muzzle flashes that sit where they should.

**Graphics**
- Brightness now defaults to 1.0 for a darker, more defined image (your own brightness setting is kept).
- Fixed sky flicker around the sun on Ultra.
- Your shadow no longer stays on screen after you die or while spectating a teammate.
- Fixed: flickering shadows on grass and fences (DX12).
- Fixed: player shadows sometimes started away from the player (DX12).
- Fixed: a rare one-frame flicker when a frame needed a lot of geometry (DX12).
- Crash reports now include more detail to help us fix graphics driver crashes.

**Gameplay**
- The M4 SOPMOD's red dot no longer hangs in the air when you push the gun against a wall.
- Running out of breath while holding sprint no longer makes your view stutter.
- Standing, crouching and going prone now look smoother, in first and third person.
- You can no longer fire while your weapon is pulled back against a wall.
- Small steps and thresholds under low ceilings and door frames no longer stop you.
- Muzzle flashes now sit at the end of the barrel and follow the gun on every weapon, in first and third person, including both guns when firing akimbo.

**Voice chat**
- Fixed voice activation never transmitting on real microphones, and the push-to-talk keys now always transmit.
- Options > Voice now lets you pick your microphone and output device, with a live microphone level meter.

**Matches and interface**
- Voice and callout icons over heads now only show over your own teammates, so they no longer give away an enemy's position through walls. Servers can turn them off, and players can hide them with cg_voiceSprites 0.
- Changing team now tells you on screen when the switch happens, or why it was refused.
- Competitive matches: round numbers, round results and the scoreboard now follow the match, and side swaps no longer flood the feed or put the whole team on one spawn spot.
- Community map names now read properly on the tactical map, scoreboard and map vote (for example "Villa 2.1").

**Launcher 3.0.3**
- Patch notes cards now show the update number ("Update 0.39.0") instead of the same cut-off title three times.
- Changing the featured story no longer leaves the old headline showing through the new one.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum 0.39.0 (Front Lines)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.39.0**
**Patch Notes #67**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.39.0-sandbox37

Smarter opponents, four classic community maps, a rebuilt launcher and a deeper layer of atmosphere on every map.

**Smarter bots**
- Bots now listen. Footsteps and gunfire give away your position, and they remember where they last saw you.
- Bomb mode plays like a real match: attackers agree on a plan and can cover their entry with smoke, defenders hold sites and regroup to retake together.
- Bots choose when to hold, push or fall back, and vary their peeks instead of rushing in one line.
- Teams learn which round plans work on each map and adapt over a session.
- The end of a round no longer causes a brief hitch on servers with bots.
- Bots with sniper rifles now use the scope on every difficulty.
- Bots no longer freeze in front of you while you aim down a scope. If they can't get out of your line of fire, they crouch and keep moving.
- Bots no longer climb the same ledge over and over, and the bomb carrier no longer keeps switching between sites.
- Bots that got stuck at the start of their route, or somewhere with no route (a roof, a pit by a ladder), now find their way out.
- One bot keeps the defuse or bomb pickup job, and bots no longer stand inside you when you stop.
- Bots walk quietly when they know an enemy is close, and round starts with many bots are smoother.

**Community maps**
- Four of the most played TrueCombat:Elite community maps return: Villa 2.1, Shozen, Snowtown and Chlite, playable on Unranked servers.
- Several of their original sounds have been cleaned up and levelled to sit alongside our own ambience.
- Stadtrand gets its second bomb site back: site A now works on every server, Ranked included.
- Community maps have minimaps, tactical maps and loading screens with a map plan, picture and description.
- Bots pick up the flag on Villa 2.1 in Flag Capture.
- The site A crate on Villa 2.1 breaks when the bomb goes off.

**Interface and match screens**
- Clearer match screens: map names read properly on the scoreboard and tactical map, round results name the teams ("Terrorists win the round"), and Bomb, Flag and Capture Point objective cards say what to do next.
- Capture Point: the point is marked on the tactical map and the minimap.
- Team Deathmatch and Flag: waiting players see "Deploying in N" instead of "No more deployments this round".
- Spectators of team matches get the team scoreboard and the right status texts.
- The firing range panel no longer overlaps the minimap and says how many targets are up. The FPS counter no longer sits on the minimap.
- Small in-game UI sizes keep all text readable.
- Match end: the podium is lit the same on every map, and the game view dims behind the map vote.
- Kill feed, chat box, vote menu, weapon pickup prompt and first-launch tips no longer overlap or cut off text.
- Flash grenades also blind the minimap, compass and objective card.
- The final-kill replay camera no longer ends up inside the shooter or behind a fence.

**Graphics**
- Smoother baked lighting, with soft shadow edges on walls and floors.
- Trees, bushes, grass and canvas sway gently in the wind.
- Sun shafts and soft glare when looking toward the sun (DX12).
- Wet patches on the ground that reflect the world around them (DX12, Ultra).
- Water ripples from players and gunfire.
- Higher-detail fire and explosions, and smoke lit briefly by blasts and muzzle flashes.
- Brick, cobblestone, gravel and rock gain real depth up close, from height maps that match their lighting (DX12, Ultra).
- Aiming down sights softens the rear of your own weapon while the sights stay sharp (DX12).
- Frost forms at the edges of your view in the cold on Snow and fades indoors.
- Each map gets its own subtle colour mood.
- Ranked servers and clan matches keep sun shafts, glare, colour mood, lens frost and lit smoke off, so every player sees the same picture.

**Combat feel and immersion**
- **Focus zoom.** While aiming, hold the right mouse button to steady your view with a slight extra zoom. Release to return to your normal sight picture. With hold-to-aim, the sprint key focuses instead.
- Gear rustles and magazines rattle as you move, and the last round in the magazine ends with a dry click.
- At low health you hear a slow heartbeat that quickens as you near death, sound dulls and colour drains from the world.
- After a long sprint you catch your breath.
- Fallen soldiers settle naturally: bodies fall away from walls, keep a little of their momentum and come to rest along slopes and stairs.

**Player models**
- Your sidearm now rides on your right thigh, your knife on your left hip and your grenades on your belt, so everyone can see what you carry.
- The support hand now sits on the handguard on every two-handed weapon in third person.
- When spectating another player, their weapon now moves with them: sprint, aim, sway and bob are all visible.

**Launcher 3.0.2**
- A completely rebuilt launcher: live server cards on the Play page, a new server browser with favourites, recent servers and search, and news with full articles.
- **Friends.** Add friends by code, see who is playing, and join or invite in one click. Optional and off until you turn it on.
- Downloads panel with pause and resume, a dark tray menu with quick play, and update notifications.
- New Accessibility settings: high contrast, larger text, colour-blind friendly markers and reduced motion.
- The launcher is now also available in Dutch.
- Includes the repair improvements from launcher 2.6.2: missing or damaged files are downloaded again automatically, and errors now say what went wrong.

**CQB (experimental)**
- CQB spawn rules now apply only in the CQB Rules playlist. Every other mode keeps standard spawns.
- Official #2 (Unranked) now runs with experimental content on: the new CQB weapons are in every match, and Harbour joins the rotation as Team Deathmatch.
- CQB Rules: health regeneration and the Protected and Tank perks are no longer undone by the next hit.

**Fixes**
- Fixed game sound fading away or turning into thumps a few seconds into a match on audio devices set to high sample rates (96 kHz and above).
- Bomb rounds are no longer scored twice when the explosion takes someone with it.
- The bomb's explosion now hurts everyone nearby and counts for the player who planted it.
- SpecOps can no longer plant a bomb they picked up.
- Blocked rotating doors no longer swing backwards on servers.
- Grenades and smoke from the previous round are cleared when a new round starts.
- Players no longer slide down slopes while standing still, and stay planted when running downhill.
- Pulling the pin on a grenade is now audible to you and nearby players.
- Northport's harbour ambience plays again. It had been silent since the original release.
- Smoother movement along the glass fronts on Railhouse, and fewer small freezes the first time a sound or effect is used.
- A "Connection interrupted" notice appears when the server stops answering.
- Recorded demos play back without menus opening over them.
- The M4 SOPMOD sight shows a single red dot at 1440p and 4K.
- Bug reports (F12) at high resolutions no longer say the screenshot is too large to upload.
- The Deployment menu closes when the match ends.
- Replaced an unused system sound that shipped with the original game files.
- We've tightened and expanded our security measures.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.38.2 (0.38.2-sandbox36)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.38.2**
**Patch Notes #66**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.38.2-sandbox36

# TrueCombat: Platinum 0.38.2
**Hotfix**

- Fixed game sound fading away or turning into thumps a few seconds into a match on audio devices set to high sample rates (96 kHz and above).

## Launcher 2.6.2
- When an update fails, the launcher now shows the exact reason in Settings > Updates, in the status panel and on the PLAY button, instead of a generic "Update check failed".
- If your antivirus blocks or quarantines a game file, the launcher names the file and asks you to add the TrueCombat Platinum folder as an exception.
- Missing or damaged game files are detected at startup and replaced automatically. Verify and repair now works in every situation, including after a failed update.

*Your game updates automatically through the launcher. If your sound cut out in 0.38.1, it is back after this update; there is nothing to change in your settings. Thank you for playing, and keep the reports coming.*

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.38.1 (0.38.1-sandbox35)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.38.1**
**Patch Notes #65**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.38.1-sandbox35

# TrueCombat: Platinum 0.38.1
**Hotfix**

- Fixed some antivirus programs (Avast, AVG, Avira) wrongly flagging the game during the 0.38.0 update, which stopped the game from starting.
- Fixed the weapon and arms swinging wildly while moving.

## Launcher 2.6.2
**Launcher update, 18 November 2026**

- When an update fails, the launcher now shows the exact reason in Settings > Updates, in the status panel and on the PLAY button, instead of a generic "Update check failed".
- If your antivirus blocks or quarantines a game file, the launcher names the file and asks you to add the TrueCombat Platinum folder as an exception.
- Missing or damaged game files are detected at startup and replaced automatically. Verify and repair now works in every situation, including after a failed update.
- Leftovers from an interrupted or blocked update are cleaned up automatically, and downloads retry when the connection drops.
- Fixed PLAY repeatedly offering INSTALL when the game engine was missing.
- Every update step is now logged to updates\launcher-update.log in the game folder.

*The launcher updates itself the next time you open it. Your game files and settings are untouched.*

*Your game updates automatically through the launcher. If 0.38.0 would not start for you, open the launcher and let it update: it replaces the missing file. Thank you for playing, and keep the reports coming.*

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.38.0 (0.38.0-sandbox34)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.38.0**
**Patch Notes #64**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.38.0-sandbox34

Our biggest update yet. Content from TrueCombat: CQB arrives on an experimental front, you can now take weapons off the battlefield, there's a firing range, and a long list of changes makes every firefight hit harder.

**Experimental: TrueCombat: CQB comes to Platinum**
Content from TrueCombat: CQB by GrooveSix / Team Terminator, rebuilt for Platinum. It runs on servers that enable experimental content and stays out of Ranked play and the leaderboards while we tune it.
- **Harbour.** A new close-quarters map, fully rebuilt for DX12 with its own minimap and tactical map.
- **Experimental Arsenal.** Thirteen weapons enter testing, including the M1911, USP .40, Shorty, MP9, Mini Uzi, SCAR, SG 552, REC7, G3 and the M110 marksman rifle, with dual M1911s and dual Shorties. Find them under the new Experimental tab in the Deployment Menu.
- **CQB Rules.** A fast-paced playlist with Bodycount (first team to 20 kills, quick respawns), perks such as Lightweight, Protected, Tank and Commando, and health that recovers after a few seconds out of the fight.
- **New movement.** Commando can grab ledges and climb, corner sliding keeps you moving along walls, and spawns place you away from the enemy.
- **New optics and sound.** ACOG, EOTech, Leupold and M68 sights, a new radio voice and indoor reverb.

**New Features**
- **Battlefield pickups.** Weapons now drop when a player falls. Walk up to an enemy's weapon and press Use to swap it for your own, with whatever ammunition its owner left behind. Enabled on official Ranked and Unranked servers.
- **Firing range.** Choose Firing range from the Play menu to sight in every weapon on targets from 10 to 100 metres. Each hit shows where it landed, the damage and the distance, with your accuracy for the session.
- **Vaulting.** Press jump at a low wall, crate or window to vault over it or climb on top. The classic mantle stays as it was.
- **Know when to jump in.** With the launcher in the background, Windows lets you know when people are playing on a public server. One click and you're in. You can turn it off in Settings.
- **Female soldier option.** Choose Male or Female under Options > Customise Game > Player. Both use the same hitboxes, so the choice is purely visual.

**Aim and Performance**
- Aiming down sights now zooms and changes sensitivity the instant you press the key, with no round-trip delay.
- New **Aim speed** option: keep the Classic feel, or match your aim sensitivity to your hip-fire feel.
- New **Frame Rate Limit** option in Options > System, from 60 to 500 FPS. The launcher no longer forces 125 FPS.
- Movement, stamina, recoil recovery and jumping now behave the same at every frame rate.
- Lower input latency on DX12, with tighter frame pacing.

**Firefights**
- Explosions now shake the camera by distance, throw dust from the ceiling, scorch the ground and leave dirt on your screen.
- Indoor haze, drifting dust, falling leaves and birds that scatter at the first shot bring every map to life.
- Impacts react to what they hit: sparks on metal, splinters on wood, glass that breaks properly, and water splashes.
- Blood spreads into pools, uniforms pick up blood and dirt, and players flinch when hit and fall according to where they were hit.
- The death camera now drops and rolls with the body before fading out.
- A replay of the final kill closes out each round.
- New first-person touches: a dip when you land, the gun pulls back at walls, and spent magazines drop on reload.
- Footprints in the snow, muzzle flashes that cast shadows, heat shimmer from hot barrels and gunfire that sounds different indoors and at range.
- Combat voice lines: soldiers call out contacts, kills and casualties.
- An optional Auto-hide HUD fades the HUD out when you're not in the fight. It is off by default.

**HUD**
- **Minimap.** Choose a round (new default) or square minimap in Options.
- **Bomb mode.** Everyone sees "Bomb planted at <location>" when the bomb goes down. A new bomb card shows the site, a countdown and defuse progress, and the carrier gets clear hints, including a warning when they try to plant outside a site.
- Hit and suppression effects now fade smoothly at the screen edges instead of showing dark bands.
- Kill messages show long weapon names in full, for example the AK-74M Spetsnaz.
- Grenades now appear by their proper names: M67, M84 and M83.
- The game window is now titled TrueCombat: Platinum.

**Weapons and Visuals**
- Upgraded first-person weapon models and materials, with sharper metal, wear and texture detail on DX12.
- New player gear for both teams.

**Bots**
- Bots vary their routes in Bomb and Elimination, so rounds no longer play out the same way twice.
- When a player drops out mid-match, a bot holds their place until they return.

**Launcher and Installer**
- New Play page artwork captured in-game.
- Optional crash and hardware reports help us fix problems faster. The launcher asks once, and you can change your choice at any time under Settings > Privacy.
- A much smaller installer: setup is now under 1 MB and fetches the latest verified launcher during installation.
- Every download on truecombat.eu is now scanned by VirusTotal and listed with its SHA-256 checksum.

**Fixes and Stability**
- Cleaner map loading, with stray console errors removed.
- We've tightened and expanded our security measures.

Thanks to GrooveSix / Team Terminator for TrueCombat: CQB.

*Your game updates automatically through the launcher. Thank you for playing, and keep the reports coming.*

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.37.3 (0.37.3-sandbox33)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.37.3**
**Patch Notes #63**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.37.3-sandbox33

Loud and clear. Sound that survives Windows changing your audio device, a kill feed that shows every player in their own colours, and steadier skies on DirectX 12.

**Audio**
- Fixed game audio going silent until a restart when Windows switched or reset your audio device. Sound now recovers by itself within a few seconds.
- This covers headsets and USB or Bluetooth devices reconnecting, monitor audio dropping out on a display change, audio enhancers restarting and a new default output device.
- Fixed a rare case where the game stayed muted or frame-capped after alt-tabbing back in.
- The new console command **s_alReopen** restarts the audio device by hand if you ever need it.

**Kill Feed**
- Players now appear in the kill feed in their own name colours, with their team shown by a coloured bracket around the name.
- Names without colours keep the familiar team-coloured look.
- The same applies to obituary lines, the death card, the damage report and the voice and network cards, on both the Platinum and Classic HUDs.

**HUD**
- Very dark name colours are brightened just enough to stay readable on the HUD, while keeping their hue.
- The in-game What's New card is updated for this release.

**DirectX 12**
- Steadier skies with DLSS, DLAA and TAA. Cloud layers, the horizon and the sun no longer shimmer while you stand still or turn.

*Your game updates automatically through the launcher. Thank you for playing, and keep the reports coming.*

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.37.2 (0.37.2-sandbox32)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.37.2**
**Patch Notes #62**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.37.2-sandbox32

Eyes up. A live minimap, hits you can feel, friendly fire, and a game that finally looks like Platinum from the taskbar to the first frame.

**Minimap & Tactical Map**
- A live **minimap** now sits in the top-right corner. It turns with your view and shows the map layout, the bomb sites, north and your own team. Enemies never appear on it.
- The objective panel and network readout move down to make room, and return to their usual place when the minimap is off.
- Turn it on or off under **Options > HUD & Effects**.
- **M** opens the tactical map again, including on existing profiles.
- Servers that disable the tactical map also hide the minimap.

**Combat Feedback**
- **Hit feedback:** taking damage now kicks your view, flashes red and leaves a blood mark on the side the shot came from.
- **Suppression:** rounds cracking past you desaturate the edges of the screen and shake your view.
- Both effects work with the Platinum and Classic HUDs, in DirectX 12 and OpenGL.

**Friendly Fire**
- **Friendly fire is now on.** Bullets, knives and grenades hurt teammates. Check your target.
- Team kills are counted as team kills and no longer add to your score.

**HUD**
- The Platinum kill card replaces the centre-screen "You were killed by" line. The Classic HUD keeps the original line.
- Coloured player names now show their full colours in Platinum chat, the Deployment Menu and HUD cards.
- The in-game What's New card is updated for this release.

**Gameplay**
- Grenades now play their pin-pull and throwing animations in first person, and leave from your throwing hand instead of the centre of the screen.
- Bots are ready faster when a server rotates between game modes on the same map.

**Names & Accounts**
- If your name is reserved by its owner, the game now tells you why you are playing as "Player####".
- Names that imitate staff tags are now cleaned more thoroughly.

**Identity**
- The game window, taskbar and Task Manager now show the Platinum icon and the name "TrueCombat: Platinum".
- The Team Terminus and Platinum intro now plays before Play, Join and Practice, not just when the game opens to the menu.

**Performance**
- Lighter, smoother Windows dedicated servers.

**Launcher 2.5.1**
- Play, Join and Practice now start the game through the intro.

*Your game updates automatically through the launcher. Thank you for playing, and keep the reports coming.*

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.37.1 (0.37.1-sandbox31)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.37.1**
**Patch Notes #61**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.37.1-sandbox31

A big follow-up to 0.37.0. A HUD you can size and tune to your liking, a cleaner ammo and health readout, tighter shotgun and sprint handling, smoother map loads, and a long list of fixes from your reports.

**HUD & Interface**
- New **Menu size** (50-100%) and **In-game UI size** (50-150%) sliders, adjustable in 5% steps.
- Opacity is now split three ways: HUD panels, HUD text and icons, and chat.
- The centre-screen "You killed" notice is gone. The death card now sits bottom-right and fades out after about 2.5 seconds.
- Map loading screens are back.
- The HUD round timer and team scores can now be shown or hidden separately.
- The FPS counter option now works.
- Default Settings restores the correct Platinum key layout, and new players get F3 for Call a vote.
- Key changes made in game are no longer overwritten by the launcher.

**Ammo & Health**
- Your ammo is now shown as a magazine icon with an exact count of spare magazines, just like the original.
- The ammo panel shows the icon of the weapon in your hands.
- New **Check Magazine** key to see how full your current magazine is.
- The reload prompt has been removed, and the empty-gun click is louder so you know when you're dry.
- A body silhouette now shows where you've been hit, and warns you when you're limping or close to death.
- The official servers show the silhouette only. On community servers that allow it, health numbers can be turned on in the options.

**Gameplay**
- Automatic weapons now fire at exactly their original TrueCombat:Elite rates.
- Bolt-action rifles cycle at their original speed again.
- Pump shotguns now fire at the correct rate, with a full pump between shots.
- The shotgun reload no longer plays a doubled, delayed sound. You hear one shell going in at a time.
- Aiming down sights now ends a sprint, and you can no longer sprint on an empty stamina bar.
- Weapon switching now plays its proper animation.
- Frag grenade explosions have been restored to their original look in both DirectX 12 and OpenGL.
- Each class now uses its own character model.
- Thrown frag grenades no longer show the smoke grenade model.
- Bullet holes and blood are cleared at the start of every round.
- In borderless window mode, the mouse now stays on the game's monitor.

**Bots**
- Improved bot pathfinding, so bots get stuck less and take better routes.
- Bots are better at keeping out of your line of fire.

**Performance & Stability**
- Fixed stutter caused by the graphics cache being rebuilt on every map load.
- Fixed several cases where the game could hang during startup or while connecting.
- Frame Generation now pauses while the game is minimised or in the background.
- The previous session's console log is now kept, which makes crash reports more useful.
- Restored nine sounds that were missing.

**Graphics**
- More world textures now have specular detail on the Ultra preset.
- HDR reflections have been tuned for a more natural look.

**Names, Accounts & Reports**
- Orange is now available to everyone in the name colour picker.
- Fixed account holders sometimes joining as "Player####" when their account took a moment to verify.
- Bug reports (F12) now keep your draft until it has been sent.
- We've tightened and expanded our security measures.

**Launcher 2.5**
- **HD textures are now optional.** Turn them off under Settings > Updates to save disk space and download time. If any HD files are missing, the launcher fetches them for you.
- With HD textures off, you can still join any server without downloading them first.
- The News page and patch notes load again.
- "What's New" no longer overlaps the Support button, and the layout holds up in maximised and larger windows.
- Only one launcher runs per install, so no more duplicate tray icons.
- Your desktop shortcut no longer disappears after an update.
- Cleaner download progress text and improved German, French and Polish translations.

**Studio**
- A new intro: the Team Terminus card, followed by the Platinum logo. The old intro movies and exit screens have been replaced.
- Intro music: "Venom" by Scott Buckley, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

*Your game updates automatically through the launcher. Thank you for playing, and keep the reports coming.*

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.37.0 (0.37.0-sandbox30)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.37.0**
**Patch Notes #60**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.37.0-sandbox30

Our biggest update yet. A completely redesigned interface, new ways to see the battlefield, optional player accounts, smarter bots, and a long list of fixes from your reports.

**A New Look**
- Every menu and the HUD have been rebuilt in the new Platinum style.
- Prefer the original? The classic HUD is one switch away in the options.
- Each map now has its own loading screen.
- Clearer, friendlier screens when a connection fails or a server is full.
- Prompts now show your actual key bindings.
- Kill feed icons are now rendered from the real weapon models.
- A "What's new" card greets you after each update.
- New **Menu size** option (100/90/80%) under Options > HUD & Effects, and a HUD that fits narrower screens.

**See More of the Fight**
- **Tactical map:** hold **M** for an overview of the map and your squad.
- **Match-end podium** celebrates the top players of every match.
- **Photo mode** and camera paths for screenshots and videos.
- **HDR10 output** for HDR displays (Options > Graphics).
- **Per-map colour grading** (optional, off by default).
- The Graphics menu now shows an estimated GPU cost and a preview for each setting.
- The sharpen slider now scales smoothly from zero, so low values give a gentle effect.
- Fresh installs start on the graphics preset recommended for your card.

**Player Accounts (optional)**
- Link your PC to a TrueCombat account, or link in seconds with your phone.
- Switch between profiles in the launcher.
- Reserve your name and show a clean-record tick on your profile.
- New "Looking for a squad" option on the Servers page.
- Playing without an account works exactly as before.

**Gameplay & Fixes**
- You can jump while running or sprinting on flat ground again, and stamina recovers while you run.
- Fixed walking (Caps Lock) with Always Run giving a speed boost far above sprint speed.
- Weapon keys are back in order: **1** primary, **2** secondary, **3** knife. Vote options match the keys you press.
- An empty magazine now gives a clean dry-fire click instead of looping the firing animation.
- Grenades thrown while leaning leave from where your eyes are.
- Spectating a teammate now shows their aim, stance and lean correctly.
- Blood effects are back.
- **Bomb is now one life per round.** Players who join mid-round wait for the next one.
- Fixed missing textures on the hands and pliers while defusing.
- The SIG 552 and SPAS-12 sights are now correctly aligned.
- The shotgun now pumps after every shot.
- Aiming down sights now has a subtle weapon sway that grows while moving and after sprinting.
- Fixed legs flickering into idle or jump animations while running on slopes.
- Bullets hitting windows now show glass impacts.
- Every option in the settings menus was checked to make sure it changes, applies and saves what it says. Several that did not now do.

**Bots**
- Bots step clear of your line of fire as soon as you raise your sights or fire.
- Bots stay on the objective in Bomb and CTF instead of chasing every sound.

**Servers & Voting**
- Map votes now only offer maps from the server's rotation, and a vote no longer breaks the mode rotation.
- Each player's vote limit now carries over a map restart.
- We've tightened and expanded our security measures.

**Launcher 2.4**
- New tray panel and full controller navigation.
- Updates can now download individual files, so future updates are smaller and recover better from a bad connection.
- Note: the first update from 0.36 is a larger one-time download.

**Studio**
- A new Team Terminus intro and an updated Credits page.

*Your game updates automatically through the launcher. Thank you for playing, and keep the reports coming.*

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.36.1 (0.36.1-sandbox29)
body:

**Patch Notes #59**

A focused hotfix for the issues you reported after 0.36.0. Thank you to everyone who played and sent in feedback. Update through the launcher, or install fresh with TrueCombat-Platinum-Setup.exe.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.36.0 (0.36.0-sandbox28)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.36.0**
**Patch Notes #58**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.36.0-sandbox28

0.36.0 adds voice chat, team pings, smarter bots, a full audio overhaul and a name colour picker. It sharpens online shooting, keeps the install folder from growing and sends F12 bug reports straight to the development team. Update through the launcher, or install fresh with TrueCombat-Platinum-Setup.exe.

**NEW: VOICE CHAT**
- **Team radio:** hold **H** to talk to your team. Enemies never hear it.
- **Local voice:** hold **N** to speak out loud. Everyone nearby hears you, enemies included.
- **Options > Voice:** voice on/off, volume, microphone gain and input device, push to talk or voice activation (with an adjustable level), radio effect, mute the enemy team, and an on-screen list of who is talking.
- **Microphone test:** hear yourself without sending anything.
- **Mute players:** mute single players from the mute menu.
- **Keys:** both voice keys can be rebound in game and in the launcher's Controls. B stays the radio menu.
- Voice works on servers that enable it.

**NEW: TEAM PINGS**
- Press **middle mouse** to mark a position, or point at an enemy to call them out. Your team sees a marker for 5 seconds with a short notice.
- Team modes only. Pings are rate-limited to keep the screen clean, and `cg_pings 0` hides other players' marks.

**NEW: BOTS**
- **Bots now read the map.** They spread across multiple routes, take doorways one at a time, slow down and check corners, and aim down sights when holding an angle.
- **Bots take a moment to spot you.** Distance, lighting, movement and stance all count, so instant snap reactions are gone.
- Bots no longer camp spawn exits.
- **Personalities:** each bot now has a name and a personality from a 32-strong roster. Some play aggressively, others play it safe, and each has its own preferred weapons.
- **Callouts:** bots call out enemy positions by map location on team chat and report bomb and flag events (adjust with `bot_chat`).
- **Team orders:** bots respond to typed team orders such as "follow me", "hold here" and "push", and always confirm they are bots when asked.
- **Adaptive difficulty:** with humans in the game, bots adjust their skill to keep matches close (disable with `bot_adaptive 0`).

**NEW: AUDIO OVERHAUL**
- **More sounds at once:** the game now plays twice as many sounds at the same time. In a full firefight, enemy footsteps and gunfire take priority over ambience and shell casings instead of being dropped.
- **Balanced mix:** every sound in the game has been levelled for loudness, category by category, and a master limiter stops loud moments from clipping.
- **Gunfire takes the stage:** nearby shots and explosions briefly lower the rest of the mix so they cut through.
- **Natural variation:** footsteps, gunfire, impacts and casings vary slightly in pitch, so repeated sounds no longer sound identical.
- **Bullet crack and whizz:** rounds passing close to you crack and whizz by.
- **Explosion aftermath:** a nearby blast muffles your hearing for a moment and lands with a low thump. The ringing in your ears is now a softer tone (the original beep is still available).
- **Options > Audio:** a new page for the new sound settings, including the bullet crack, the ringing tone and how strongly gunfire lowers the rest of the mix.

**NEW: NAME COLOURS**
- Colour each letter of your name in the launcher: Settings > Controls > Player > Name colours. It includes a live preview, click-and-drag selection and 26 colours.
- Coloured names now show correctly on the scoreboard, in chat and in the Deployment Menu with every ET colour, not just the first ten.

**ONLINE PLAY AND HIT REGISTRATION**
- **Smoother updates:** the launcher now asks servers for 64 updates per second instead of 40, so movement and hits update more smoothly on 128-tick servers.
- **Hit marks match the server:** your game now uses the server's exact rules to decide whether a shot hit, so hit marks and the server agree.
- **Heads and legs register:** shots at heads and legs that stick out past a player's hitbox now count. Before, these sometimes missed at certain angles and stances.
- **Steadier on poor connections:** your input is resent until the server confirms it, and packet duplication adapts on its own to unstable connections.
- **128 updates per second:** a new Options > System > Network updates setting lets you receive 128 updates per second on 128-tick servers. 64 stays the default and uses about half the bandwidth.
- **Steadier at high update rates:** the game now keeps a longer history of server updates, so packet loss and lag spikes no longer force full resyncs at 128 updates per second.
- **Fairer for low-ping players:** lag compensation now rewinds at most 250 ms (was 400 ms).
- **New net graph:** `cg_netGraph 3` shows ping, packet loss in both directions, updates per second, snapshot gaps, prediction corrections and packet duplication.

**STORAGE**
- **The install folder no longer grows:** the DX12 shader cache used to save a fresh copy on every map change, which could add up to several gigabytes. It now keeps a single copy that is reused across servers and maps.
- **Size limits:** the launcher keeps caches, replays, screenshots and bug reports under a size limit, removing the oldest files first. Settings > Storage shows how much space replays and caches use.
- The first start of launcher 2.1.0 clears any oversized cache left by earlier versions.
- Updates no longer clear the shader cache twice, so your first match after an update loads faster.

**BUG REPORTS (F12)**
- F12 reports now go straight to the development team: description, map, position, server, match, build, renderer, ping, frame rate, recent console lines and a screenshot. Hardware info is optional.
- Every report is still saved on your PC. If sending fails, the game tells you and keeps the report.
- `cg_bugReportUpload 0` keeps reports on your PC only.
- `bugreport <text>` in the console files a report straight away.

**SECURITY**
- We've tightened and expanded our security measures.

**LAUNCHER 2.1.0**
- **Player count:** the Play button shows how many people are playing and your ping ("12 playing · 38 ms").
- **New options:** name colour picker and voice keys in Controls, in English, German, French and Polish.

**WEAPONS AND VISUALS**
- **M4 SOPMOD red dot:** the M68 sight now shows a crisp red dot when aimed. The reticle no longer shows as a blurry square.
- **DLSS:** if a DLSS override in the NVIDIA App takes over, the game now says so instead of failing silently.

**FIXES**
- Hit markers on edge shots (head and leg grazes) now always match what the server counts.
- Options > System > Calibrate Brightness opens correctly again.
- Your own predicted shots now play the correct sound for the weapon you are holding.
- Spectators stay spectators after a map change or restart instead of being put into a team.
- Footsteps and view bob now follow toggled walk and sprint correctly (`cg_toggleWalk` / `cg_toggleSprint`).
- Server browser: after "Invalid password", Reconnect now reconnects to that server. Joining from the in-game browser also works mid-match.
- Local voice and quick voice chat (V menu) now work in Practice and free-for-all modes.
- F8 replays: clips need at least 5 seconds of play, and the "Clip saved" notice shows the real clip length.

**BEHIND THE SCENES**
- Every round is now recorded (winner, kills, objectives) for match history and leaderboards. No personal data is stored.
- Opus voice codec added, with its licence included under Licences.

Thanks to everyone who played, reported and tested. See you on the servers.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.35.0 (0.35.0-sandbox27)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.35.0**
**Patch Notes #57**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.35.0-sandbox27

Easy Anti-Cheat, a rebuilt launcher, an in-game server browser, a proper warm-up, grenade cooking and a long list of movement, weapon and map fixes from the latest playtest. Update through the launcher, or install fresh with TrueCombat-Platinum-Setup.exe.

**EASY ANTI-CHEAT**
- TrueCombat: Platinum now ships with Easy Anti-Cheat. PLAY starts the game through the Easy Anti-Cheat bootstrapper, and the installer sets up the anti-cheat service once (Windows asks for permission).
- Servers that require anti-cheat show a green shield in the in-game server list and an EASY ANTI-CHEAT tag in the launcher; servers with anti-cheat switched on but not required show ANTI-CHEAT ON. The connect screen states the server's anti-cheat status.
- Anti-cheat sign-in uses a TrueCombat identity created on your PC. No account or sign-up is needed.

**LAUNCHER 2.0**
- Redesigned launcher with English, German, French and Polish text.
- Server cards show the game mode, verified community servers and when the list was last checked.
- truecombat:// join links open the game and connect straight to the server. A second copy of the game no longer takes these links over from your installed copy.
- A name set in the game, including colour codes, is no longer replaced by the launcher on the next start. A name typed in the launcher still takes priority. Names can be up to 35 characters.
- The Controls page now includes the Walk key (Caps Lock by default).

**SERVER BROWSER AND WARM-UP**
- FIND SERVERS in the main menu and the Esc menu opens the in-game server browser: browse, filter and join servers without returning to the launcher.
- Warm-up is now a practice phase before the first round: you spawn straight away, respawn one second after dying, and can try weapons, change your loadout and talk to other players. The match starts after a 30-second countdown once two players are present (server hosts: g_warmup). Warm-up kills and deaths do not count.

**MOVEMENT**
- Jumping onto low objects works as in the original game: standing next to an object such as a dumpster, the jump is no longer reduced, so you can climb on it. Higher ledges are still climbed with the ledge climb.
- Aiming down sights now slows you down as in the original game.
- Footsteps and head bob follow the original timing. Crouched footsteps are slower and quieter, and walking, aiming and leaning are quiet.
- You can no longer fire while sprinting. The weapon is ready again a quarter of a second after you stop.

**GAMEPLAY**
- Grenade cooking, as in TC:E 0.49b: hold fire to prime a grenade and release to throw it with the remaining fuse. Hold it too long and it leaves your hand just before it goes off. You cannot switch weapons while a grenade is primed.
- Bolt-action rifles (R93, SR-8): the bolt is now worked after you release the trigger, with its own sound, before the next shot can be fired.
- Jump landings follow the original recovery rules: a hard landing or a landing from a jump briefly reduces how high you can jump again.
- Fall damage now hits the legs instead of the body. The total damage is unchanged.
- Grenade blasts check line of sight to several points on the target, so cover protects you properly.
- Flashbangs now blind bots as well as players.
- Explosions are no longer muffled by walls and floors near the blast.
- Suppressed weapons are harder for bots to hear.
- New toggle options for sprint and walk (cg_toggleSprint, cg_toggleWalk), next to the existing crouch toggle.

**DOORS**
- Doors show a use icon under the crosshair when you can open them, and play their opening and closing sounds.
- Opening a door while walking or crouched opens it slowly and quietly. Doors can no longer be reversed halfway through a swing.

**WEAPONS**
- Players and bots now visibly shoulder their weapon when aiming down sights.
- The M4 and the M4 SOPMOD are separate entries in the weapon list again.
- The AKS-74U charging handle is textured correctly.
- When spectating, weapon sounds and firing animations match what the player hears and sees.

**MAPS**
- Removed the invisible capture-point posts that blocked movement outside Flag Capture, including the one at the Delta bomb site.

**ONLINE PLAY**
- Server hosts can set a join password (g_password). Players without the right password are refused with a clear message.
- Team selection: bots no longer count toward team size limits, every team switch is confirmed, and a team picked while the map is still loading is kept, including for the next map.
- Teams are no longer reshuffled at the first round of a new map. Automatic balance only steps in when the teams are really uneven and moves bots before players.
- Rejoin within five minutes and keep your team and score.
- Timed bans with a reason shown to the banned player, a ping limit for servers (g_maxPing), pickup-match teams, and a connection quality icon on the scoreboard. cg_netGraph 1 or 2 shows ping, packet loss and jitter.
- Match reports now record connection quality and leaves. Player addresses are never stored.

**INTERFACE**
- Chat works again: T for all players, Y for your team.
- V opens the voice command menu.
- New MOUSE & VIEW page in the Esc menu: sensitivity (with typed values for high and low DPI mice), aim and scope sensitivity, field of view (80 to 110, cg_fov), mouse smoothing and acceleration.
- Report a bug from inside the game: press F12 or use REPORT A BUG in the Esc menu. The report includes your recent console log.
- Kill feed lines stay on screen for 15 seconds. Adjust with cg_killFeedTime.
- Player names in the deployment menu now show colour codes ^8 and ^9 correctly.

**FIXES**
- Fixed grenades firing again when fire was held after the last grenade was thrown.
- Fixed players respawning with outdated movement timing after a respawn.
- The connect screen no longer shows unrelated engine release messages.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.34.1 (0.34.1-sandbox26)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.34.1**
**Patch Notes #56**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.34.1-sandbox26

Instant replay clips, a per-life damage report, fairer teams in long matches and a fix for offline bot matches. Update through the launcher.

**NEW**
- Instant replay: press F8 (or type /clip) to save the last 30 seconds of play as a clip in demos/clips. Watch it with /demo clips/<name>. Clip length is set with cl_replaySeconds; cl_replay 0 turns the feature off.
- Damage report: when you die, a DAMAGE THIS LIFE panel under the killed-by card shows the damage you dealt to and took from each opponent. Survive a round and you get the ROUND DAMAGE summary instead. Turn it off with cg_damageReport 0; server hosts can disable it with g_damageReport 0.

**ONLINE PLAY**
- Team balance during the match: in Team Deathmatch and Flag Capture, when one team is two or more players larger for 15 seconds, one player on the bigger team is moved while waiting to respawn. Each player is moved at most once every five minutes, and never during competitive matches. Server hosts: g_autoBalance and g_autoBalanceDelay.
- Fill-in players: when someone leaves a match that is under way, the server now reports the open place to server lists. Players who join the short team are thanked and cannot lose rating in that match. Server hosts: g_backfill and g_backfillTime.

**FIXES**
- Fixed offline bot matches appearing to freeze after two minutes: the away-from-keyboard check moved you to spectator. It now only runs on dedicated servers.
- DLSS Frame Generation: added safeguards that switch it off for the rest of the session if it starts toggling on and off or a frame takes longer than one second to appear. If the game still freezes with Frame Generation on, turn it off in Options and report it.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.34.0 (0.34.0-sandbox25)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.34.0**
**Patch Notes #55**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.34.0-sandbox25

A redesigned launcher, a Custom graphics preset, weapons that feel alive, the original voice commands, ultrawide support, Discord Rich Presence and a long list of quality-of-life features. Update through the launcher; the new launcher installs itself first.

**LAUNCHER 1.4.0**
- A complete visual redesign in the TrueCombat.eu style, with a Launcher update button.
- Quick Play finds the best server for you, and the server browser gets filters.
- Profile & demos page with identity backup.
- The Hosting dialog now fits smaller screens.

**GRAPHICS**
- New Custom graphics preset: pick Low, High, Ultra or Custom and turn every graphics option on or off, in the launcher and on the new in-game Graphics page.
- Ultrawide support: 21:9 and 32:9 screens now get a wider field of view instead of a zoomed-in picture, and the HUD stays in a comfortable centred area (cg_hudAspect).
- Fixed taking a screenshot on very high resolution screens, such as 5120x1440, disconnecting you from the game.

**WEAPONS AND MOVEMENT**
- Weapons and movement feel alive: view and weapon bob, sway and recoil kick, sprint, crawl and ladder weapon poses, smooth stance changes, ejected shell casings, gear worn on the back, heartbeat and scope breathing.
- The original fall damage is back (server option g_fallDamage).
- The original ledge climbing sounds.
- Original camouflage on soldier models and first-person sleeves.
- Bullet impact effects can be switched off (cg_impactEffects).

**VOICE COMMANDS**
- The original TC:E voice commands return: vsay, vsay_team and vsay_buddy, with the original voices and text. Server hosts can limit them with g_voiceChatsAllowed.

**QUALITY OF LIFE**
- Killed-by card and damage direction indicator.
- Player votes, quick radio, mute and chat history.
- Automatic demos, loadout presets and a separate scope sensitivity.
- Optional hit feedback (always off on Ranked).
- Accessibility options and practice tools (g_practice 1).
- A modern new in-game font.

**ONLINE PLAY**
- Discord Rich Presence: your Discord profile now shows the server, mode, map and live score, and friends can join your match straight from Discord. Turn it off with cl_discord 0, or hide match details with cl_discordPrivate 1.
- Skill-based team balance from player ratings (g_balanceSkill), and spectators are no longer pulled into teams.
- Away-from-keyboard players are moved to spectators after two minutes (g_afkTime), never in competitive matches.
- /report a player from the console; reports reach the staff.
- Server-side demo recording (sv_autoDemo) and a faster bot start on every map.
- Bomb servers now report the correct mode name.

**SERVERS**
- Server hosts: a native Linux dedicated server kit is now built for every release and attached to it on GitHub shortly after publication.

**STATUS**
- Easy Anti-Cheat is built and nearly through testing. It ships in the next update.
- Coming next: shadows from muzzle flashes and explosions, and a Discord pickup queue.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.33.0 (0.33.0-sandbox24)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.33.0**
**Patch Notes #54**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.33.0-sandbox24

Our biggest visual update yet. The new Ultra preset brings modern lighting, real surface materials and real-time sun shadows to every map on DirectX 12, with NVIDIA Frame Generation for RTX 40-series cards. Gunfire now leaves its mark on the world, first-person combat has been rebuilt around the original animations, ledge climbing returns, and bots fight smarter and work as a team.

**ULTRA VISUALS (DIRECTX 12)**
- New Ultra graphics preset in the launcher.
- Real-time sun shadows from players, props, weapons and the world, with contact shadows for grounded detail.
- Modern lighting: filmic tone mapping, automatic exposure and a restrained colour grade that keeps players easy to read.
- Surface materials on every map. Brick, metal, wood and concrete now respond to light with depth and sheen.
- Ambient occlusion and reflections tuned per map.
- Anti-aliasing picks itself: NVIDIA DLAA on RTX cards with 12 GB of video memory or more, TAA everywhere else.
- Materials are compressed and cached on first load, so later map loads stay quick.
- Low, High and OpenGL keep the classic look, unchanged.
- Server hosts can require the classic look for every player with sv_forceClassicVisuals 1.

**FRAME GENERATION AND REFLEX**
- NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation is now available as an opt-in setting under Advanced graphics in the launcher, for GeForce RTX 40-series and newer cards on the Ultra preset.
- NVIDIA Reflex is on in Ultra for lower input latency.

**COMBAT**
- Bullet impacts are back. Every surface takes the original per-material bullet holes, on entry and exit, with dust, splinters, sparks and blood.
- Original impact sounds, plus the crack of a near miss as rounds fly past.
- New first-person muzzle flash for every weapon.
- Sniper scope overlay when aiming down a scoped rifle.
- First-person animations rebuilt from the original TC:E set: last-shot slide lock, alternating akimbo hands, separate partial and empty reloads, and shell-by-shell shotgun reloads.
- Switching weapons now lowers the old weapon before raising the new one.

**MOVEMENT**
- Ledge climbing returns. Jump at a ledge to pull yourself up, just like the original.

**BOTS**
- Sharper, more human aim: situational reactions, flicks that settle on target, and realistic tracking. Bots never fire through a teammate.
- Smarter movement: bots slow down near danger, stop to shoot, strafe at close range, reload behind cover and spread out across routes.
- Real teamwork: shared callouts, support pushes, trading kills, and buddy pairs in Team Deathmatch and Elimination.
- Bomb and Capture the Flag objective play stays as sharp as before.
- Fixed bots standing idle on Delta.

**INTERFACE AND LAUNCHER**
- New Esc pause menu, centred and dimmed on every screen shape.
- The launcher now has its own version number (Launcher 1.0.0), shown in the title bar, the update bar and the Versions dialog, and it can update itself separately from the game.

**PERFORMANCE**
- New frame-time graph: cl_drawFrameGraph 1 shows frame times, average fps, 1% lows and spikes, on DirectX 12 and OpenGL.
- Detailed frame statistics for troubleshooting with cl_frameStats and cl_frameSpikeMs.
- The console log is now written in the background, removing hitches on slow disks.

**FIXES**
- Fixed the black void below the water on Northport. Looking up from underwater now shows the water's colour, on DirectX 12 and OpenGL.
- Fixed the console log being cut short when the game closed after an error.
- The cheat detection recognises the new materials pack and the updated interface files.

**STATUS**
- Easy Anti-Cheat is prepared but not switched on yet.
- Coming next: shadows from muzzle flashes and explosions, a full launcher redesign, and voice commands.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.32.0 (0.32.0-sandbox23)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.32.0**
**Patch Notes #53**
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.32.0-sandbox23

A major update. Movement now runs at the original TC:E pace, and leaning, ladders, swimming and spectating are back. This release also brings a competitive match mode, smarter bots on every objective, a new-player welcome, a one-click installer, and a fix for the most common crash to desktop.

**MOVEMENT AND GUNPLAY**
- Movement speed matches the original TC:E. Running, sprinting, crouching and going prone all move at the original speeds.
- Walk and run animations now switch at the original speed, so other players move the way you remember.
- Stamina recovers when you walk, stand still, crouch or go prone, like the original.
- Third-person animations now follow the original TC:E set: weapon-specific stances for rifles, pistols, knife and grenades, a raise animation on weapon switch, prone pistol poses, and death animations that react to how and where a player is hit.
- Bullet tracer lines are gone. Muzzle flashes now show correctly on every player and light up their surroundings on DirectX 12 and OpenGL.

**NEW ORIGINAL CONTENT**
- Lean around corners with Q and E.
- Climb ladders. Bots use them too.
- Swim, dive and drown. Northport's water is fully swimmable.
- Glass, wood and metal now shatter into debris.
- Defusing a bomb puts the pliers in your hands.
- When you die, the camera follows a living teammate and shows their health and ammo.
- Suppressors: the MAC-10, MP5, M4 and AKS-74U now have a Suppressor toggle in the Deployment Menu, using the original suppressed variants and their trade-offs.

**COMPETITIVE MATCH MODE**
- Organised matches with ready-up, an optional knife round, side pick, halftime side swap, tactical timeouts and a final score screen.
- Server admins run it with the match rcon commands. Players use ready, notready, timeout, stay and swap.

**BOTS**
- Bots now play the objective. They plant and defuse the bomb, carry the flag home, and take and hold the capture point, with team callouts in chat (bot_chat).
- Point Capture is fairer. The point is now placed at an equal walking distance from both spawns, and it takes 30 seconds to capture (g_captureHoldMs).
- Fixed: a single bomb detonation could award the round to the attackers more than once.

**NEW PLAYERS**
- First launch now opens a three-step welcome: the basics, your controls, and how to start playing.
- New in the launcher: Practice offline with bots starts a Railhouse Team Deathmatch against bots in one click.
- New players see nine short tips during their first matches. Turn them off with cg_tips 0, or bring them back with tips_reset.

**INSTALL AND UPDATES**
- The download is now a small installer: TrueCombat-Platinum-Setup.exe. It installs the launcher, and the launcher downloads the game.
- Choose your install folder, with desktop and Start menu shortcuts and a proper uninstaller.
- New Versions button in the launcher: stay on an older release, or switch back to the latest at any time.

**ONLINE**
- The in-game server browser now lists official Platinum servers.
- Ranked hosting: server owners can enter a ranked key in the launcher's Hosting tab, so their matches count towards the leaderboards.
- Team Terminus staff now carry a verified emblem and an orange name on the scoreboard.

**INTERFACE**
- The HUD, scoreboard, Deployment Menu, map vote and main menu now fit every screen shape, from 4:3 to 32:9 super-ultrawide. Nothing gets cut off at the edges any more.

**PERFORMANCE**
- Removed the long freezes that happened the first time a weapon or explosion appeared in a match. Weapon and effect media now load with the map.

**FIXES**
- Fixed a crash to desktop when a player was kicked or banned, or the server restarted or shut down.
- Your team, class and loadout are now kept after a map restart or map change.
- The cheat detection no longer flags the game's own HD and interface files.
- The speed check no longer misfires after a freeze or alt-tab.
- Elimination rounds now last 5 minutes, like the original (server cvar tcp_roundtime).
- Restored missing crosshairs and server-browser icons.

**STATUS**
- Easy Anti-Cheat is prepared but not switched on yet.
- Still to come: the first-person muzzle flash, a sniper scope overlay, ledge climbing, and the modern Ultra visuals.
- In DirectX 12, water seen from above in third person can render black.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.31.0 (0.31.0-sandbox22)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.31.0**
**Patch Notes #52**
**Full TC:E Build** 0.1.0-rc8
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.31.0-sandbox22

The biggest update yet. The full TC:E arsenal, real recoil and penetration, three new game modes, bots, 3D sound, the Deployment Menu, end-of-match map votes, lag compensation, player ranks and server admin tools.

**WEAPONS**
- The full TC:E weapon roster is in, with each team's own weapons, pistols and grenades, and semi, burst and full-auto fire modes where the original had them.
- Original recoil and spread. Each weapon kicks, sways and settles like TC:E, aiming (zoom key) tightens your shots, and moving, jumping and landing throw your aim off.
- Bullets go through walls, doors and crates the way they did in TC:E, losing damage with every surface. Thin cover no longer saves you.
- Original damage, reload times and weapon-switch times for every weapon, including shell-by-shell shotgun reloads and the nine-pellet shotgun spread.
- Knife, frag, stun and smoke grenades work again, with stun and blast effects.
- Weapons now show on other players, with their own original firing and reload sounds.

**GAME MODES**
- New: Team Deathmatch, Flag Capture and Bomb, alongside Practice, Elimination, Team Elimination and Point Capture. Pick them in Hosting.
- Map objectives, timers, rotating doors, breakable glass and wood, and all map props and ambient sounds are back.
- End-of-match map vote: when a match ends, everyone votes for the next map with the number keys. Most votes wins.


**DEPLOYMENT MENU**
- The original Deployment Menu is back. Choose your team, class and loadout before you spawn, or reopen it any time with the limbo menu key.
- Team balance is enforced: you cannot join the bigger team.

**BOTS**
- Practice and fill games with bots. Set the number of bots and their skill (1-5) in Hosting. Bots navigate every stock map, take cover, aim with human-like reaction time and fill empty slots on your server.

**SOUND**
- Full 3D sound: gunfire, footsteps and ambience come from where they happen and follow your view.
- Walls muffle sound, rooms have their own echo, and distant gunfire carries across the map.
- Original surface footsteps for stone, metal, wood, grass, snow, water and more. Walking is silent, sprinting is loud.
- Optional headphone 3D sound (HRTF): set s_alHRTF 1.

**ONLINE PLAY**
- Lag compensation: the server checks your shot against where players were on your screen, so hits you see are hits that count.
- Recoil, spread and your own shots are now predicted on your PC, so firing feels instant even with high ping.
- Fewer lost inputs on unstable connections (cl_packetdup now defaults to 2).


**RANKS AND STATS**
- Your kills, deaths, accuracy, headshots and wins now count towards an XP rank and a skill rating, shown on the Leaderboards page of the website. No account needed.

**SERVER HOSTS**
- New admin commands over rcon: kick, ban, unban, ban list, and an admin log.
- Edit the map rotation live with maprotation add, remove and move. It is saved and survives a restart. Set rounds per map with g_roundlimit.
- Built-in cheat detection: the server flags speed hacks, timing tricks, aim snaps and altered game files.

**PERFORMANCE**
- Smoother DirectX 12: render states are prepared while the map loads instead of in the middle of a fight, removing most first-time stutters.

**LAUNCHER**
- The public server list is live: hosted games that choose List publicly now show up for everyone in the Servers tab.
- Hosting now offers Team Deathmatch, Flag Capture and Bomb, plus bot count and skill.
- If the game crashes, the launcher offers to save a crash report you can send us, and Report a problem includes it.

**ALSO NEW SINCE 0.29.0**
- HD textures for the world, models, HUD and menus. Remove the zzz_hd_*.pk3 files from tcetest to get the original look back.
- Low / High / Ultra graphics presets. High is the default, and Ultra adds stronger effects and NVIDIA DLAA where available.
- The original TC:E chat box, kill feed, death notices and Tab scoreboard.
- The M83 smoke can be thrown underhand: press the zoom key with the M83 in hand.
- Updates now download only the files that changed.
- The Servers tab shows the public server list. Hosts can choose List publicly in Hosting & favorites.

**STATUS**
- Easy Anti-Cheat is prepared but not switched on yet.
- Leaning, ladders, swimming and the spectator mode are still to come.
- Your weapon choice resets after a map restart. Pick it again in the Deployment Menu.
- Tested on one PC over local connections. Separate PCs and the internet are not verified yet.
- Use the separate RC8 download for complete TC:E matches.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.29.0 (0.29.0-sandbox20)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.29.0**
**Patch Notes #50**
**Full TC:E Build** 0.1.0-rc8
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.29.0-sandbox20

New download for the native 64-bit sandbox. The launcher becomes a full hub with a living map header, a server list and in-launcher news, and movement looks smoother online.

**LAUNCHER**
- The header now moves slowly through real in-game shots of all six maps and cross-fades between them.
- New Play, Servers and News tabs.
- Servers shows your favorite and recent servers and your own server as cards with a map picture, player count and ping. Click a card to pick it, double-click or press JOIN to play, and use the star to save a favorite.
- News shows the latest patch notes inside the launcher.
- Hosting & favorites (formerly Servers & hosting) now lets you pick the starting map from picture cards.
- Smoother hover effects, rounded window corners on Windows 11, a larger window on high-resolution screens and dark drop-down lists.

**UPDATES**
- Updates are now signed by Team Terminus. The launcher only installs updates that carry a valid signature.
- While an update downloads you can see its speed and time left, cancel it, or open What's new.

**MULTIPLAYER**
- Fewer camera jolts from small movement corrections when packets arrive late or go missing.
- Respawns and practice resets stay instant, without a camera slide.
- Respawning players no longer slide between their old and new positions.
- Movement-correction smoothing can be adjusted or turned off through the console.

**STATUS**
- Still unfinished: recoil, spread, penetration, leaning, ladders, swimming, aiming down sights and the original round rules.
- There is no public server list yet. The Servers tab shows servers you have saved or joined before.
- Tested on one PC over local connections. Separate PCs and the internet are not verified yet.
- Use the separate RC8 download for complete TC:E matches.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.

name: TrueCombat: Platinum v0.28.0 (0.28.0-sandbox19)
body:
**TRUECOMBAT: PLATINUM — v0.28.0**
**Patch Notes #49**
**Full TC:E Build** 0.1.0-rc8
**Packaged Native Sandbox** 0.28.0-sandbox19

New download for the native 64-bit sandbox. It brings the restyled launcher with a built-in update bar, optional DLSS/DLAA, steadier startup and a new connection version.

**LAUNCHER**
- New title bar that blends into the artwork, with the game emblem, your version and window buttons that match the rest of the launcher.
- New update bar above the PLAY button. It shows your version, checks for new versions, downloads and verifies them, and installs them on restart. Your settings, profile and server data are kept. It checks the official TrueCombat: Platinum releases on GitHub each time the launcher opens.
- Servers & hosting, Advanced graphics and the graphics report now have proper headers and grouped panels.
- Smoother corners, soft shadows, icons on the section headings and clearer drop-down lists.
- Text stays sharp when the launcher window is resized.
- The Advanced graphics window no longer cuts off its notes and buttons.

**GRAPHICS**
- Added optional NVIDIA DLSS and DLAA for RTX graphics cards. It is off by default. Enter r_dx12Dlss 1 in the console for DLAA, or 2 to 5 for the DLSS quality levels, then vid_restart.
- The game now recovers more gracefully when a graphics renderer fails to start.

**MULTIPLAYER**
- New connection version. Version 0.28.0 cannot join 0.27.0 or older servers, and older versions cannot join 0.28.0 servers.
- A clear message now explains when your game and the server do not match.

**STATUS**
- Still unfinished: recoil, spread, penetration, leaning, ladders, swimming, aiming down sights and the original round rules.
- Tested on one PC over local connections. Separate PCs and the internet are not verified yet.
- Use the separate RC8 download for complete TC:E matches.

**DEVELOPMENT**
- Developed by RaziC* — Team Terminus.
